what: [config-drift] Two resolvers for accounts.yaml can disagree. src/runtime/strategy_monocle.py::_accounts_declaring (used by #14590's per-account gate when a dispatch round has no E35 scope) reads via src/config/accounts_loader.load_accounts_dict, whose _resolve_path honours the ACCOUNTS_YAML_PATH env var FIRST; Coordinator.multi_account_execute ignores that env var and always loads <repo>/config/accounts.yaml (src/core/coordinator.py ~L962). No repo-tracked unit file or script sets ACCOUNTS_YAML_PATH (grep over src/ scripts/ config/ deploy/); the VM's runtime environment was NOT checked. If it is ever set, the gate would compute the round's declared-account set from a different file than the one the coordinator dispatches from; because account_scope only narrows, the effect is an account wrongly dropped (never wrongly added).
why_it_matters: A silent divergence here can drop a real-money account from dispatch with a scope nobody can explain from accounts.yaml.
